shortDescription: NetApp Element Software Add/Remove Volumes to/from Access Group

options.name: access_group
options.description: Name or id for the access group to add volumes to, or remove volumes from

options.name: account_id
options.description: Account ID for the owner of this volume. It accepts either account_name or account_id if account_id is numeric, look up for account_id first, then look up for account_name If account_id is not numeric, look up for account_name

options.name: hostname
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the SolidFire cluster. For na_elementsw_cluster, the Management IP (MIP) or hostname of the node to initiate the cluster creation from.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the specified volumes should exist or not for this access group.

options.name: username
options.description: Please ensure that the user has the adequate permissions. For more information, please read the official documentation U(https://mysupport.netapp.com/documentation/docweb/index.html?productID=62636&language=en-US).

options.name: volumes
options.description: List of volumes to add/remove from/to the access group. It accepts either volume_name or volume_id
